title: Retomada após conclusão durável nova, sem repetir a receita concluída

execution.method: Source-grounded case mining; not product execution

limits: Não é aceite global nem fechamento do AC-07.
G3-01, G3-02 e G3-03 são herdados sem novo julgamento; AC-03 não é reaberto; old-producer permanece INDETERMINATE.
Nenhum cenário permite servir bytes/sidecar untrusted. Reviews de fixture são mecânicos e explicitamente sintéticos.
minedFinding: The executor can persist completed nodes while building, but the supplied baseline is its only reuse authority. The inspected API has no durable-completion resume parameter or automatic discovery. Re-entering it with the unchanged original baseline after partial progress statically reaches the changed root recipe again; equal CAS hashes later do not undo that work.

entryPoints.symbol: no campaign-resume entry point identified in the inspected ownership rebuild API

preconditions: Use the existing contra-alphabetical dependency shape z -> a -> m, plus independent i, from zamiFixture; use a real temporary disk store for this residual instead of its in-memory createStore.
Establish baseline M0 with exact declared source/recipe/contract/dependency identities and distinct persisted structural review refs. Never infer numeric/lexical version order.
Edit file:src/core/z.ts so its observed identity changes. Confirm the independent expected affected closure is z,a,m.
Run production rebuild with recipe-call and evaluator-call counters external to the recipe. Allow z to complete through result, receipt, artifact, partial manifest and node read validation.

A transformação determinística de z deve produzir body distinto e newZResult !== baselineZResult; a ainda aponta para baselineZResult. Source drift sozinho não garante chegar a run(a), pois resultado igual pode cortar propagação.
Todos os puts do executor e do evaluator de fixture delegam ao MESMO createDiskStore. Não copiar o closure putSeeded de zamiFixture para um store diferente.

payload.beforeIdentity: Actual observed identity recorded when M0 was created
payload.afterIdentity: Different actual observed identity after the source edit; no greater/less-than assumption
payload.interruptAt: The beginning of a's recipe.run after z has been persisted and validated; kill the worker before a returns.
payload.requiredResultChange: newZResult !== baselineZResult, medido antes da barreira em run(a)

fault: At a's recipe entry, a separate observer must first read the actual z result/receipt/artifact refs from disk and record the bindings. End the writer process; no successful complete candidate result is claimed.
completionEvidenceTransport: O harness observa os puts realmente concluídos, transmite via IPC os refs reais de body/result/reviews/receipt/artifact/partialManifest e só anuncia a barreira após validar z. O observer abre outro createDiskStore e lê esses refs. Essa telemetria não é checkpoint de produto, não concede autoridade e NÃO é passada ao executor como baseline novo.
steps: Open a fresh disk store against the same directory and verify the completed z objects are intact and still bound to the unchanged captured source/recipe/contract/dependency identities.
Invoke the existing production rebuild entry with the explicitly known baseline M0 and the same current captured inputs; record all recipe/evaluator calls.
Do not invent an unseen checkpoint API, promote a partialManifest, suppress counters, or call raw CAS dedup a zero-call resume.
If a real existing caller can supply a valid complete newer manifest, record that caller and manifest authority separately; that is different from recovering interrupted partial work.
oracle: AC-07 recovery acceptance requires completed, still-valid z work to be reused without a second z recipe/evaluation; remaining a/m work may execute once, while i remains unaffected.
Any source/recipe/contract/dependency mismatch invalidates the proposed completion; no reuse of a stale or untrusted completion is allowed.
Count actual calls, not only new CAS files or unchanged hashes. No implicit publication occurs during resume.
Until a whole candidate is validated and governed activation succeeds, current reads remain valid incumbent or HOLD and no partial candidate is served.

staticPrediction.kind: source-derived prediction, not observed runtime result
staticPrediction.result: With request.manifest=M0, newResults and candidateArtifacts are reconstructed exclusively from M0; z still has changed input and reaches recipe.run again. The existing API cannot demonstrate partial-completion recovery merely by reopening its CAS.

evidence.finding: Baseline M0 reinicia mapas e dispara z de novo se bindings continuam diferentes.
store.put deduplica bytes; isso não impede receita/evaluator que já executaram.

positiveControl: After a full valid candidate M1 already exists and its identity is explicitly supplied as request.manifest, the same unchanged captured inputs allow plan.affected=[] and calls=[] (executor:213). This tests reuse of a complete baseline, not recovery from partial interrupted work.

negativeControls.control: Original baseline M0 plus already-present z CAS bytes: a repeated z recipe call falsifies the requested recovery oracle even when every put returns the prior hash.
Alter a completion's source/recipe/contract binding before resume: its reuse must be refused or rebuilt; byte persistence alone is insufficient.
Use an incomplete partialManifest as if it were accepted complete state: no activation and no ready/current reader result may follow.

evidence.finding: Obrigação AC-07 congelada; a mineração limita-se ao resíduo nomeado neste caso.
Only manifest baseline is supplied as reuse authority; request/result shape does not expose a checkpoint/resume token.
Each attempt reconstructs candidate maps from baseline; runs precisely changed recipes; CAS puts happen per node; only final complete candidate manifest is returned.

RB-19 begins with no drift, calls rebuild, creates another in-memory createStore and reseeds seeded baseline objects; executed remains empty. It never interrupts a worker, reads a real disk store or demonstrates reuse of newly completed changed work.
F1 excludes activation/recovery; CAS dedup explicitly does not count as zero-call reuse; RB-19 intention is already limited to a complete result supplied as baseline.
The frozen disposition explicitly excludes real process interruption, campaign resume and model-call deduplication.
Existing map names this exact acceptance gap without any runtime receipt.

executionGap: No accepted runtime verdict for partial interrupted completion reuse was found in the read scope. Static prediction suggests the baseline-only path repeats work; it is not a newly executed red and does not revoke G3-01.
framingError: Reopening a settled projection or reseeding an unchanged in-memory baseline was being treated as interrupted-work resume. Persistent CAS identity and durable discoverability/reuse authority are separate obligations.
scopeQualification: Persistência observável após morte do processo; não se afirma fsync dos objetos CAS ou resistência a perda de energia. O root não implementa recuperação ausente nem promove partialManifest.
